title: text-cli Path Declaration
description: Schema for text-cli path declarations. Paths are composite directive chains registered via text-cli;path --register and published via text-cli;pro.

type.description: skill = consumer-facing composite capability; pipeline = internal processing chain

mode.description: Execution mode. toolchain = linear sequential steps

input_schema.description: JSON Schema fragment describing expected input

output_schema.description: JSON Schema fragment describing expected output

requires.description: Directives required for this path to execute (domain;action format)

output_as.description: Variable name to store step output

directives.description: Filled by text-cli;pro after publication. The skill-domain directives this path is callable through.
